words.definition: a regular payment for an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ke liye niyamit bharan

sentence.sentence: The monthly premium for health insurance is quite high.
sentence.translation: svaasthya bima ke maasik primaam bahut adhik hai.

sentence.sentence: She paid her premium on time to avoid penalty.
sentence.translation: unhone dand se bachen ke liye samay par apna primaam bhara.

words.definition: an amount that must be paid before an insurance policy begins to pay
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ka bhugtaan shuru hone se pehle bharna hoga

sentence.sentence: The deductible on my health insurance is $500.
sentence.translation: meri svaasthya bima par katavayee $500 hai.

sentence.sentence: High deductible plans often have lower premiums.
sentence.translation: ucch katavayee yaantron mein aksar nichit primaam hota hai.

words.definition: a fixed amount paid by the patient for a medical service
words.definationTranslation: chikitsa seva ke liye rogī dwara bhara gaya ek nishchit bharan

sentence.sentence: The co-pay for a doctor's visit is $20.
sentence.translation: daktar ki mulaaqaat ka sah-bharan $20 hai.

sentence.sentence: My co-pay for prescriptions is $10.
sentence.translation: mere nuskhon ka sah-bharan $10 hai.

words.definition: a request for payment from an insurance company
words.definationTranslation: bima kampni se bhugtaan ke liye anurodh

sentence.sentence: You need to file a claim to get reimbursement.
sentence.translation: bharan vapas pane ke liye aapko davaa darj karnee chaahiye.

sentence.sentence: The insurance company will review your claim.
sentence.translation: bima kampni aapki davaa ka samīksha karegee.

words.definition: a medical condition that existed before the insurance policy started
words.definationTranslation: bima policee shuru hone se pehle maujood ek chikitsa sthiti

sentence.sentence: Pre-existing conditions are often not covered by insurance.
sentence.translation: purv-maurit sthitiyon ko aksar bima dwara dhakiya nahin jaata.

sentence.sentence: She had a pre-existing condition that made it hard to get insurance.
sentence.translation: uske paas ek purv-maurit sthiti thee jo bima praapt karne mein kathin thee.

words.definition: a doctor, hospital, or other healthcare professional
words.definationTranslation: daktar, aspatal, ya anya swaasthya seva pradaata

sentence.sentence: My healthcare provider is very experienced.
sentence.translation: mera swaasthya seva pradaata bahut anubhavī hai.

sentence.sentence: The insurance company has a list of approved providers.
sentence.translation: bima kampni ke paas manya seva pradaaton ki soochi hai.

words.definition: a group of healthcare providers who have an agreement with an insurance company
words.definationTranslation: bima kampni ke saath samjhauta karne vaale swaasthya seva pradaaton ka samauh

sentence.sentence: The insurance company has a large network of providers.
sentence.translation: bima kampni ke paas seva pradaaton ka bada jaal hai.

sentence.sentence: I need to choose a provider within the network.
sentence.translation: mujhe jaal ke andar se ek seva pradaata chunnaa hoga.

words.definition: the amount of protection provided by an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee dwara pradaan ki gayi suraksha ki maatra

sentence.sentence: The coverage on my policy is excellent.
sentence.translation: meri policee par dhakiya utkrisht hai.

sentence.sentence: I need to check the coverage before buying a policy.
sentence.translation: main policy khareedne se pehle dhakiya jaanchanaa chaahunga.

words.definition: a condition or situation that is not covered by an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee dwara dhakiya naheen gaya ek sthiti ya paristhiti

sentence.sentence: The policy has an exclusion for pre-existing conditions.
sentence.translation: Policee mein purv-maurit sthitiyon ke liye bahishkaar hai.

sentence.sentence: I need to read the exclusions carefully before buying a policy.
sentence.translation: main policy khareedne se pehle bahishkaar kaa dhyaan se padhunga.

words.definition: the maximum amount of money that an insurance policy will pay
words.definationTranslation: bima policee dwara bhara jaane vaala dhan ki adhiktam raashi

sentence.sentence: The policy has a limit on the amount of coverage.
sentence.translation: Policee mein dhakiya ki maatra par seemaa hai.

sentence.sentence: I need to check the limit before filing a claim.
sentence.translation: main davaa darj karne se pehle seemaa jaanchanaa chaahunga.

words.definition: the act of paying back money to someone who has paid for a medical service
words.definationTranslation: chikitsa seva ke liye bharna vaale vyakti ko bharan vapas karne ka kaam

sentence.sentence: The insurance company will provide reimbursement for the treatment.
sentence.translation: bima kampni ilaj ke liye bharan vapas karegee.

sentence.sentence: I need to submit my receipts for reimbursement.
sentence.translation: mujhe bharan vapas ke liye mere rasaideon ko prastut karanaa hoga.

words.definition: paid by the patient, rather than by an insurance company
words.definationTranslation: bima kampni ke baajay rogee dwara bhara gaya

sentence.sentence: I had to pay out-of-pocket for the prescription.
sentence.translation: mujhe nuskhon ke liye apne kharche se bharna padaa.

sentence.sentence: The out-of-pocket costs for healthcare can be very high.
sentence.translation: svaasthya seva ke liye apne kharche se kharch hote hain.

words.definition: a person who helps people choose and buy insurance policies
words.definationTranslation: ek vyakti jo logon ko bima policee chunne aur khareedne mein madad kartaa hai

sentence.sentence: The broker helped me choose the right policy.
sentence.translation: madhyasth ne mujhe sahee policee chunne mein madad kee.

sentence.sentence: I need to contact a broker to get a quote for insurance.
sentence.translation: main bima ke liye uddarpan praapt karne ke liye ek madhyasth se sampark karoonga.

words.definition: an estimate of the cost of an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ke kharch ka anumaan

sentence.sentence: I got a quote from the insurance company.
sentence.translation: maine bima kampni se uddarpan praapt kiya.

sentence.sentence: The quote includes the premium, deductible, and co-pay.
sentence.translation: uddarpan mein primaam, katavayee, aur sah-bharan shaamil hain.

words.definition: the process of registering for an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ke liye nirmaan praakriyaa

sentence.sentence: The enrollment period for the new policy is open.
sentence.translation: naye policee ke liye nirmaan avadhi khulee hai.

sentence.sentence: I need to complete the enrollment process to get insurance.
sentence.translation: main bima praapt karne ke liye nirmaan praakriyaa poora karoonga.

words.definition: the act of paying the premium for an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ke primaam ka bharan karne ka kaam

sentence.sentence: The premium payment is due on the 15th of every month.
sentence.translation: primaam bharan har mahine ke 15 ve din kee jaat hai.

sentence.sentence: I need to make the premium payment to avoid penalty.
sentence.translation: main dand se bachen ke liye primaam bharan karoonga.

words.definition: a person who receives the benefits of an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ke laabh praapt karne vaalaa vyakti

sentence.sentence: The beneficiary of my policy is my wife.
sentence.translation: meri policee ke labhpaatri meree patnee hain.

sentence.sentence: I need to designate a beneficiary for my insurance policy.
sentence.translation: main apni bima policee ke liye ek labhpaatri nirdhaarit karoonga.

words.definition: the process of evaluating the risk of an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ke jokhim ka moolyankan karne ka prakaar

sentence.sentence: The underwriting process takes several days.
sentence.translation: bhoomika prakaar kai din lagtaa hai.

sentence.sentence: The underwriter will review my application and determine the premium.
sentence.translation: bhoomikaakaar meri aavedika ka samīksha karega aur primaam nirdhaarit karega.

words.definition: a person who investigates and settles insurance claims
words.definationTranslation: bima davaaon ka anveshan aur nibandhan karne vaalaa vyakti

sentence.sentence: The adjuster will investigate the claim and determine the payout.
sentence.translation: samayojak davaa ka anveshan karega aur bharaan ka nirdhaar karaga.

sentence.sentence: I need to contact the adjuster to discuss my claim.
sentence.translation: main apni davaa par charcha karne ke liye samayojak se sampark karoonga.

words.definition: a person who owns an insurance policy
words.definationTranslation: bima policee ka maalik

sentence.sentence: The policyholder has the right to cancel the policy.
sentence.translation: policee dharaak ko policee radd karne kaa adhikaar hai.

sentence.sentence: I am the policyholder and I need to make the premium payment.
sentence.translation: main policee dharaak hoon aur mujhe primaam bharan karnaa hoga.
